Screening mammography of bilateral breast with CC and MLO views:

Comparison of previous mammography(date): not available(first mammogram).

Breast composition: BIRADS density C - heterogeneously dense breasts, which may obscure small masses.

Findings:
Patient hesitated to go to GS OPD, PE showed mass like sensation.
Regional coarse heterogenous, fine linear branching microcalcification in left UOQ breast, malignancy suspected.
Left nipple retraction, borderline size left axillary lymph nodes noted.

BI-RADS assessment:
(BI-RADS category 5, highly suggestive of malignancy, recommend tissue proof)

Recommendation: tissue proof by breast US if mass found.

IMP: Regional coarse heterogenous, fine linear branching and pleomorphic microcalcification in left UOQ breast, invasive cancer suspected and probably with nodal metastasis. Tissue proof suggested.
